test_title: PYST 10: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'HAWKS’ is written as 'TJXZI' and 'DARES' is written as 'TDSZE'. How will 'FADED' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/-V-Jb1a3CGQRF2WtleiBgYoVL7WLXGPVUapNjiTTARX5YlMJYT8hJIa5fIQJktyAMYVBnRYXZFZkXDWKRzO6lbcb_DyCsL6mB1LzqcPAcl2GBGcjFg4Tbc_PUbzen90mRsqCHRVDGJ5uKaHgQCnqZwsjpggWg1NUrvpQlsv3S6rtqq9WoLZW4dPIMn1X] 

HAWKS is coded as TJXZI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fef9aeffc8a8b36d640aaf58751aedabadb87447e723b87022f27affde21557d.png] 

DARES is coded as TDSZE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91195b6e33561c14945a209e2d68be56cd3a31ffd3a450aeac71c3ea53845d49.png] 

Similarly,

FADED is coded as EDEZG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74321d326fb8ec51ce322181f61f2cf8dd22a49d1b66b58a49c66bbbbdb71d39.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"EDEZG".**
